chaining: The largest Misskey instance in existence (~600k users) so the best-tested API, BUT registration is CLOSED: the /api/meta description states in Japanese that new signups are suspended because the cloud provider for their servers suffered unauthorised access and they cannot add capacity. limits_note: per-object-cap 500 MiB; per-user 10 GiB; request-rate is the real constraint here (huge shared IP pool, aggressive per-IP limits).
reliability_note: Registration closed as of this probe; operator explicitly cannot expand capacity. The 500 MiB per-object number is still the useful data point: it proves the family's per-object ceiling.
